correctness.rationale: Exact local enumeration of all indegree/outdegree restrictions and both possible cycles; two good covers with checked intersection nerves; rim sphere and overlap sphere; null inclusion into a higher-dimensional sphere; cofibration homotopy pushout gives integral wedge for every n>=3. Five independent finite direct-graph/model comparisons and mod-2 rank checks corroborate the definitions, not substitute for the all-n proof.

originality.rationale: The full primary literature comparisons and targeted multiple-alias searches did not identify an equal or stronger two-cycle, one-way-perfect-matching multipath homotopy classification; importantly the 2024 graph-minor comparison excludes directed cycles, and bidirectional polygon calculations address a different construction. Prior generic conflict encodings alone do not determine this homotopy type. Publication novelty remains subject to an unindexed-equivalent risk.
residual_risks: A nonindexed equivalent directed-cycle multipath homotopy computation may exist.
The theorem is intentionally limited to coherent, equal-length rim cycles and one-way, bijective spokes; changing these hypotheses requires new analysis.

value.rationale: Gives complete integral sphere-wedge classification for all lengths and all matching twists in a natural directed-cycle ladder family including oriented prisms and Petersen graphs. The two different sphere dimensions and twist invariance are structural: the orientation changes the original graph but not the multipath topology, while previously studied directed polygons and acyclic-graph comparisons do not supply these data. Proof is exact rather than a finite catalogue.
